snippet.title: HeroSquare (indie retro metroidvania, releasing in 2025)
snippet.description:
HeroSquare on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/2440500/HeroSquare/

Armed with your ability to parry & reflect enemy bullets, you must explore a colourful metroidvania world that looks like a 1980s arcade game. Return to the Golden Age of gaming, as you fight enemies, face formidable bosses and discover new powers!

#indiegame #metroidvania
